definition: Stable identifier for a solo artist, duo, group, or recurring ensemble.

definition: Primary public or credited name.
allowed_values_or_format: UTF-8 text

definition: Organizational form of the act.
allowed_values_or_format: solo; duo; band; collective; ensemble; rotating_project

definition: Self-identified gender for solo artists; configuration for groups.
allowed_values_or_format: woman; man; nonbinary; mixed; collective_unknown; unknown
coding_notes: Never infer from appearance, name, voice, or dress.

definition: Birth year for solo artists or formation year for acts.

definition: Primary performance or composition languages.

allowed_values_or_format: none_reported; informal_peer; ustad_shagird; school_college; conservatory_university; mixed; unknown

definition: Highest completed level, self-reported.
allowed_values_or_format: primary_or_less; secondary; higher_secondary; bachelor; postgraduate; other; prefer_not_to_say; unknown

allowed_values_or_format: none; occasional; substantial; opposed_financially; mixed; prefer_not_to_say; unknown

allowed_values_or_format: 0 or greater

definition: Number of verified releases in observation window.
allowed_values_or_format: 0 or greater

definition: Professional status at August 2026.
allowed_values_or_format: active_primary; active_secondary; intermittent; paused; exited; deceased; unknown

definition: Management arrangement at observation end.
allowed_values_or_format: self_managed; informal_friend_family; independent_manager; agency; label_managed; mixed; unknown

definition: Participation status and seasons.
allowed_values_or_format: none or season numbers separated by |

definition: Verified foreign or multinational distributor.
allowed_values_or_format: Organization name

definition: Share of total personal earned income attributable to music in a defined year.
coding_notes: Collect for 2014/entry, 2019, 2022, and most recent feasible year rather than one timeless answer.

definition: Sources contributing to music-related income.
allowed_values_or_format: live; brand; streaming; YouTube_ads; composition; production; teaching; sync; session_work; neighboring_rights; merchandise; grants; other; unknown

definition: Non-performance work sustaining the artist.
allowed_values_or_format: none; education; salaried_nonmusic; freelance_nonmusic; music_teaching; production_engineering; advertising; family_business; caregiving; student; other; unknown

definition: Inflation-adjustable annual gross music income band for selected year.
allowed_values_or_format: 0; under_100k; 100k_499k; 500k_999k; 1m_2_49m; 2_5m_4_99m; 5m_9_99m; 10m_plus; prefer_not_to_say; unknown
coding_notes: Record reference year and whether gross or net.

definition: Typical weekly hours of unpaid promotion, fan interaction, administration, and rehearsal.
Largest recurring professional cost categories.
allowed_values_or_format: recording; video; marketing; travel; equipment; software; management; legal; rehearsal; wardrobe; security; childcare; other; unknown

definition: Whether artist receives interpretable royalty or distributor statements.
allowed_values_or_format: regular_clear; regular_unclear; irregular; none; not_entitled; unknown

definition: Approximate share of masters in observed catalogue owned or co-owned by artist.
Researcher-administered score based on understanding of master, composition, publishing, neighboring, sync, and recoupment rights.
coding_notes: Report item-level response patterns, not just a potentially smug composite score.

definition: Platforms for which artist or team has creator-dashboard access.
allowed_values_or_format: YouTube; Spotify; Apple; TikTok; Meta; distributor; none; unknown

definition: Verified editorial playlist inclusion and perceived pathway.
allowed_values_or_format: none; direct_pitch; distributor_pitch; label_pitch; organic_unknown; multiple; unknown

definition: Use of legitimate paid digital promotion.
allowed_values_or_format: never; occasional; routine; campaign_specific; unknown

definition: Whether release or creative strategy changed in response to platform incentives.
allowed_values_or_format: none; shorter_intros; release_frequency; collaboration; metadata; video_clips; pre_save; influencer_seeding; language_choice; hook_design; other; unknown

definition: Self-reported harassment related to music activity.
allowed_values_or_format: none; occasional; recurrent; severe; dangerous_to_disclose; prefer_not_to_say; unknown

definition: Extent to which travel, rehearsals, venues, or late hours constrain work.
allowed_values_or_format: none; manageable; significant; career_limiting; dangerous_to_disclose; unknown

allowed_values_or_format: gender; class; ethnicity; language; religion_sect; disability; sexuality; region; age; none; prefer_not_to_say; unknown

definition: Share of platform audience outside Pakistan where creator analytics are available.
Countries with verified paid performances in observation window.
allowed_values_or_format: ISO country codes separated by |

definition: Verified major domestic or international awards and nominations.
allowed_values_or_format: Structured text with year and award

definition: Triangulated assessment of whether music supports a durable professional career.
allowed_values_or_format: fragile; partially_sustainable; sustainable; high_growth; not_assessable
preferred_source: Derived from income, continuity, rights, and interview
coding_notes: Do not derive from fame or follower counts alone.

definition: Audit score for artist record.
allowed_values_or_format: A; B; C; D; exclude

definition: Ambiguities, changes over time, and protected contextual detail.
allowed_values_or_format: Maximum 3000 characters
